correctness.rationale: For every n>=2 and 1<=s<=n-1, a supercoupon S is unseen exactly when it contains all previously omitted vertices. This proves U_t=choose(n-K_t,s-K_t) for K_t<=s and U_t=0 beyond. The next missing vertex is uniform among n-1 vertices except the current one; from K_t=k, exactly n-k are new, so the distinct-count transition probability is (n-k)/(n-1). Initial K_1=1 matches iid-occupancy count plus one, proving equality of the full scalar process. Strong Markov yields independent geometric waiting times and exact CDF, PGF, mean and variance. Direct Stirling counting confirms the occupancy marginal. For s=floor(alpha n), Riemann sums give the claimed limiting mean and variance, and uniformly bounded third centered moments of geometrics plus positive limiting variance give the normal law via Lyapunov. Exact enumeration of omission paths n=2..6,t=1..6,s=1..n-1 produced 510 passing comparisons; enumeration is corroboration, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 2023 full arXiv preprint and its open 2025 journal text define this model and discuss a generic Markovian expected-cover-time conjecture and a known r=s boundary. They do not state an r=n-1 pathwise reduction, the resulting full uncollected-count process and full all-s stopping-time law, or the proportional-size normal regime. Standard iid partial-coupon formulas are explicitly recognized as prior results; the new comparison is the model-specific complement-lumping equivalence. Targeted mathematical-index and terminology searches found no equivalent covering report; this does not certify exhaustive global novelty.

value.rationale: The maximal nontrivial display size r=n-1 is a canonical boundary of the correlated hypergraph-coverage process proposed in 2023. The exact pathwise identity compresses the full history of binomial(n,s) target objects to a single occupancy count uniformly over n and all 1<=s<=n-1; it yields a whole finite-time distribution, stopping law, and a growing-s Gaussian scaling regime. These outcomes do not follow by merely quoting the fixed-parameter conjecture. It is a motivated natural complete family classification, not a numerically chosen slice or a raw reprint of iid occupancy formulas. The known s=n-1 case is explicitly attributed.
